purpose: Add an app-owned local orchestrator that turns a concrete ACM supplement zip plus an accepted workload mapping spec into a Goal5339 mapped-candidate same-input command packet.

pod_usage.reason: This goal adds the local zip-to-command-packet pipeline only. POD begins in a later execution goal after a real zip, accepted mapping, and command-ready packet exist.

allowed_summary: Goal5342 adds a local orchestrator for the existing ACM artifact inspection/hash/mapping/packet tools. It makes the future real-artifact path reproducible but does not execute commands or claim reproduction.
not_allowed: claiming the real ACM zip was processed by this status artifact
claiming author or RTDL commands were executed
